citation.authors: Shakhbazova A, Wu H, Chambers CJ
citation.journal: Journal of Alternative and Complementary Medicine

cited_by.title: Vitiligo, spread, starting age and treatment options

record.population: Human studies of diet, supplements and herbs in vitiligo (26 studies reviewed)
record.finding: Supplements reviewed included Ginkgo biloba, oral Polypodium leucotomos, alpha lipoic acid, vitamins B12, D and E, folic acid, phenylalanine and Nigella sativa oil. The authors call the evidence promising and say more studies are needed.
record.note: Abstract does not give effect sizes or say how well the supplement studies were run; read at abstract level only.
